source.public_versification_note: Public Deuteronomy 7–11 and 12:1–31 align directly; public 12:32 binds Hebrew 13:1. All 161 original XML records are hashed in full, including the numbering note.

key_decisions.decision: Preserves the emphatic ban and absence of mercy; the condition continues from verse 1 without disguising destruction as mere relocation.
Names the LORD to clarify the Hebrew divine first-person referent within Moses' address, while retaining the singular son and religious reason.
Retains the explicit thousand generations and follows the read form of commands, whose written spelling is preserved in the source record.
Retains the repeated face image and destructive repayment without replacing hatred with mere indifference.
Makes both male and female infertility explicit without treating the promise as a diagnosis of individual people's faith.
Preserves the comprehensive promise and the transfer of disease to enemies with direct divine agency.
Retains devouring and snare as the source's violent and entrapment images.
Retains hornets as the traditional concrete reading while noting uncertainty about the term.
Preserves gradual removal and its ecological reason without harmonizing the quick destruction language elsewhere.
Preserves the transfer of ban status to the possessor and the emphatic paired rejection.
